subject: English
passage: My fascination with ancient archaeological sites has driven me to explore them throughout Europe whenever I travel there. ______ I could visit every country in Europe and still not encounter the oldest known human settlement in the world. That site, Jericho, is located in the West Bank, Palestine.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. "Nevertheless" logically signals that the claim in the sentence—that the speaker could visit every country in Europe and not encounter the oldest known human settlement in the world—is true despite the previous claim about the speaker exploring ancient archaeological sites.
